topic: Campaign metric calculation and data review
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on defining the required metrics and queries for a campaign. A proposed methodology was reviewed, which involves calculating Reach by selecting specific panels within a district (e.g., 4 screens) and counting the total number of unique visitors to these screens during the selected time range, split by demographic groups. The initial query provided by [p1] was reviewed, with [me] noting that while one query covered both upper and lower sections, they could separate it. Concerns were raised about the 'reach' metric definition, as [me] had not previously tracked it. Furthermore, a specific query for the grid view across districts was noted to show unusually high numbers, and [me] planned to revise this using 'areas of living'. The session concluded with scheduling a meeting to review all metrics with additional team members.
decisions: Reach calculation will be based on counting unique visitors to a defined set of panels (e.g., 4 screens) within a district.
The grid view query for districts needs revision by [me] using 'areas of living'.
action_items: [me] to revise the grid view query using 'areas of living'.
[me] to schedule a meeting to review all campaign metrics.
